definitions.full: H8584. teudah תְּעוּדָה noun feminine testimony, attestation ; — 1 testimony , prophet. injunction , || תּוֺרָה Isa 8:16 , 20 . 2 attestation , Ruth 4:7 (> fixed usage Buhl Lex ).

occurrences.englishText: Now this was the custom in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging, to confirm all things: a man took off his sandal, and gave it to his neighbor; and this was the way of formalizing transactions in Israel.
Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.
Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
